c4c_har_2026_04_14.note: Captured from another machine (c4c). AI Center issues the same PromQL as stock dashboards: sum(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[3600s])), query_range with [60s], filters type="input" and type="cacheRead", sum by (cx_application_name|cx_subsystem_name). Token panels show correctly there—so `claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total` can be the live metric name on some tenants/regions; if yours returns 0, try `claude_code_token_usage__token__total` or confirm region and ingestion path.

metric_naming.claude_tokens: Stock HAR / AI Center uses `claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total`. In one MCP-sampled environment, token volume appeared on `claude_code_token_usage__token__total` instead, so `tokens_total` increase() was 0 there. A separate EU2 HAR (c4c, api.eu2.coralogix.com) shows the dashboard using `tokens_total` with non-zero token panels—treat naming as tenant/region-dependent until you verify which series exists in your metrics explorer.
metric_naming.gemini_tokens: `gemini_cli_token_usage_total` returns small aggregate values vs `gemini_cli_token_usage__token__total`, which shows full input/output/cache breakdown (e.g. sum by (type) on `__token__` had non-zero input/output/cache in the same window). Prefer `gemini_cli_token_usage__token__total` for token dashboards and splits.

codex_logs.notes: Codex path uses resource `service_name` (not semantic `service.name`) so DataPrime matches `$d.resource.attributes['service_name']`. Label filters such as `$l.applicationname == 'codex'` remain a fallback when resource facets differ by tenant.

codex_log_body_attributes.notes: If Codex panels stay empty after fixing the resource filter, the remaining issue is usually log-record field paths: HAR used `$d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']`-style paths. Inspect one raw log in Explorer to match actual keypaths (snake_case vs dotted names). The sim emits attributes like `event.name`, `input_token_count`, and `user.email` on the Codex logger record—your tenant’s mapping may differ from Grafana’s HAR.

claude_code_productivity_ratio.intent: Share of Claude Code active time in the CLI (AI-assisted) versus total active time (CLI + user). Matches counters emitted with label `type` in `claude_code_active_time_total_s_total`.
claude_code_productivity_ratio.grafana_interval: Replace `[1h]` with `$__range` or your dashboard interval variable if supported.
claude_code_productivity_ratio.notes: If the ratio flickers between values and empty/NaN, check Coralogix collector logs for failed scrapes of `job="otel-ai-agent-sim"` (stale pod IPs after rollout). The sim env `SIM_CLAUDE_ACTIVE_TIME_MIN_S` (default 2) raises per-turn increments so `increase()` over short windows is less often zero when scrapes are sparse.

gemini_token_metrics.notes: Coralogix uses the `__token__` form for this remote-write series; token panels that use the plain name often show no input/output split or weak totals. Use `sum by (type) (increase(gemini_cli_token_usage__token__total[$__range]))` for breakdowns.

gemini_lines_of_code_files_changed.notes: Gemini CLI (real product) exposes lines/file/tool signals per google-gemini/gemini-cli `docs/cli/telemetry.md`. The sim emits `gemini_cli_lines_changed_total` (label `type` added|removed) plus Coralogix volume mirror `gemini_cli_lines_changed__lines__total` when `SIM_GEMINI_EMIT_LINES_CHANGED_LINES_ALIAS=true` (default). Also `gemini_cli_file_operation_count_total`, `gemini_cli_tool_call_count_total`, and OTLP logs (`gemini_cli.file_operation`, `gemini_cli.tool_call`). Dashboards that show no LOC should try the `__lines__` series or widen the range / confirm Gemini-weighted emits. Claude-only metrics stay `claude_code_*`.

har_vs_coralogix.resource_service_name: Use `$d.resource.attributes['service_name'] == 'codex_cli_rs'` for Codex OTLP from this sim. Some HAR captures show `service.name`; product/UI may vary by tenant.
har_vs_coralogix.nested_log_record_attributes: Log-record pipelines that used bracket paths such as `$d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']` failed in MCP tests; align field access with Explorer / `get_schemas` for your account. Resource filtering alone is not sufficient if downstream filters still reference non-existent keypaths.
